categories_rule: the standard library ships typed descriptors and typed PluginHandle implementations for exactly the contracts, diagnostic, control, error, protocol, chat_process, routing and provider categories; every category is registered by immutable plugin id
immutable_registration_rule: each standard plugin is registered in PluginCatalog by immutable plugin_id with owner routecodex-v4-standard-plugins and canonical sha256 artifact/contract hashes; same identity re-registration is idempotent and identity drift is rejected
descriptor_rule: every standard descriptor declares an exact active node-graph node_id, role_id and position plus valid resource axis, effect, phase, order, owner and canonical hashes; unknown or mismatched node selectors are rejected before plan compilation
node_scoped_resource_rule: standard plan compilation derives exact reads and writes from the descriptor-bound active node; callers cannot broaden permissions, non-adjacent resource transitions are rejected, and provider_semantic can only flow forward into provider_wire_payload
side_channel_rule: control, error and diagnostic facts travel only in typed side channels (control carrier / diagnostics sink) and never enter normal data; payload must never reconstruct control state
keyless_rule: the baseline remains keyless: request/provider mocks are deterministic, while response plugins perform schema-bound data-plane projection without credentials or provider-specific branches
no_fallback_rule: plugin failure propagates as a typed error through the bridge; no fallback, silent strip, payload reconstruction, internal control metadata leakage, second runtime/kernel or cross-node dispatch
category_separation_rule: control-only plugins never write normal data, diagnostic-only plugins never write data or control, and provider/client metadata never leaks into wire payload
